text:
sam: Quick heads-up — small but confusing TS/ESM issue in edge-sample. Generics stop resolving after esbuild bundle: editor shows "No overload matches this call" even though code has <T>.

elaine: Which SDK and bundler?

sam: js-sdk@1.5.0rc in examples/edge-sample. Repro:

```
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = createClient();
await client.generate<{id: string}>({ prompt: 'hi' });
```

In VS Code tscserver: "Generic type 'generate' requires 1 type argument(s)" or overload mismatch. Works fine in plain node project.

hiro: Likely declaration resolution mismatch. pnpm hoisting + exports mapping can make editor pick a truncated index.d.ts in node_modules that lacks overloads. Also TS moduleResolution defaults differ.

sam: Confirmed: editor points to node_modules/.pnpm/@redwood+inference@1.5.0/dist/index.d.ts while published package has dist/types/index.d.mts with full signatures. TS didn't pick it up.

elaine: Short-term app workarounds: 1) set "moduleResolution": "bundler" in tsconfig (TS>=4.7); 2) add a path override: "@redwood/inference": ["node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.d.ts"]; 3) set "skipLibCheck": true to silence noise (nasty but effective).

hiro: SDK fixes we should implement: emit dual declarations (index.d.mts / index.d.cts), add explicit "types" entries under "exports" so TS resolves per-entry-point, and publish a small flattened API d.ts that surface stable generic signatures with defaults (e.g., <T = Record<string, unknown>>).

sam: Also noticed "declarationMap" in package.json points to sources that aren't published. Editors try to follow them and error. We should disable "declarationMap" for published builds.

elaine: Overloads are the other culprit. We had long overload chains using unknown vs any which confuse inference after bundling. Replace where possible with a single generic + helper typed utilities and prefer explicit generic defaults to help inference in constrained toolchains.

hiro: CI suggestion: add a consumer-sim test that installs via pnpm and runs tsc --noEmit in a minimal project (esbuild + moduleResolution=node and bundler) to catch these before release.

ci-bot: CI alert: examples/edge-sample lint-ts job failed with ts errors — see https://ci.internal/9001

sam: I'll open PR to: (1) add exports->types mapping, (2) emit .d.mts/.d.cts, (3) add flat index.api.d.ts with common generics, (4) turn off declarationMap for published artifacts, (5) add example tsconfig for edge with moduleResolution=bundler.

elaine: Awesome. If you can share a tiny repro repo I'll add it to the CI consumer test.

sam: Will do, PR shortly.
